programs.description: A wealthy businessman's son, Prasanta, dreams of becoming a famous singer. But when his ambition guides him to Kolkata, love is waiting for him around the corner.
A subject-matter expert conducts an informative lecture on songs composed by Rabindranath Tagore with suitable examples in a detailed and easy-to-understand manner.
The story highlights love corruption power abuse class disparity and the betrayal of true intentions by traitors.
Gopal Bhar is appointed as a jester in Raja Krishnachandra's court in medieval Bengal. His wit and humour are well-known in the region and his exploits always have a significant social message.
Dugga, a rural girl, loses her father who owned a liquor business. She meets Chiranjib, and joins him in his new venture.
Kajal falls in love with Amit, an unemployed journalist. She urges him to focus on his career and provides unconditional support, but destiny has other plans for the couple.
A mother's disappearance in her hometown leads her son to uncover a chilling truth about a serial killer, culminating in a shocking twist that delivers a powerful social message.
A comprehensive compilation of some of the most popular songs from evergreen Bollywood films composed by famous artists and musicians.

Separated during their youth, Amit and Labanya reunite in their twilight years. However, complications arise when Amit's daughter falls in love with Labanya's nephew.
Bihu, devastated by Jaba's death, pursues acting in Kolkata, finds Joita, and eventually finds love and success.
Lalita gets a job to help her sick father. When father's friend cheats them out of everything, a kind bar singer comes to their rescue and helps them out of their troubles.
After 50 years of separation, an elderly Salim and Madhuri cross paths again and rekindle their love. However, their rediscovered romance faces an obstacle in the form of her son, Subrata.
A naive clerk observes the decadent lives of a fading zamindar family. He is drawn to the lonely wife, who yearns for love amid her husband's decline and their shared ruin.
